headline: Approved adding or amending 139 voter records and removing 350 voters from the checklist.
summary: Additions and amendments covered new registrations, names, addresses, and party changes. Removals were for deaths, moves out of town, National Change of Address (NCOA) reports, and ineligibility. The June 2 minutes were also approved, with one member abstaining.
decisions: Approved adding or amending 139 voters; all present voted in favor.
Approved removing 350 voters for death, 30-day notice, registering outside the town, NCOA, or ineligibility; all present voted in favor.
Approved the June 2nd minutes; all voted in favor except John Ambrose, who abstained.

decision_evidence.quote: Kristin Grages motioned to approve the addition or amendment of 139 voters. Joseph Stelmach seconded. All voted in favor.
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the removal of 350 voters due to death, 30-day notice, registering outside of Londonderry, NCOA or voter ineligibility. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor.
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the June 2nd Minutes. Joseph Stelmach seconded. All else voted in favor. John Ambrose abstained.
